description: Cuts a PDF into parts, every N pages each or one part per entry of ranges, and returns the render with download_url: a ZIP of the parts, named after the source (contract-1.pdf, contract-2.pdf and so on), or the PDF itself when there is one part. get_pdf_info gives the page count first. Pass exactly one PDF: source, a render or library file of the workspace; path, a file on this machine; or file_base64. Starter plan and above; 0.5 units on a live key. A PDF/A or a password-protected PDF is refused.

every.description: Pages per part; give every or ranges

file_base64.description: The PDF itself, base64 encoded, up to 20 MB; sent with the request and not kept

file_name.description: Name of the PDF given as file_base64 or path, e.g. contract.pdf; the results are named after it

filename.description: Name of the file behind download_url; the source's name when left out

path.description: Absolute path of a PDF on this machine, up to 100 MB; sent with the request and not kept

ranges.description: One part per entry, each a page selection such as 1-3,5, or 4- for page 4 to the last; give every or ranges

source.description: A PDF of the workspace: the rnd_ id of a PDF render, or a PDF of the file library by name (such as terms.pdf) or fil_ id

name: split_pdf

accessibility.description: The PDF/UA-1 verdict, when the template declares it

download_url.description: Signed link to the file; null until the render succeeded

einvoice.description: The e-invoice report, when the render made one

expires_at.description: When download_url stops working; get_render issues a fresh one

form.description: What fill_pdf_form did: the fields filled, those left out (unknown name or invalid value) and those whose calculation or display format no viewer ran

output.description: The format of the file: pdf, png, jpg, webp, docx or pptx, or zip for the several files of split_pdf and pdf_to_image

pdfa.description: The PDF/A verdict (PDF/A-2b or PDF/A-3b), when the template declares it

template.description: The template and version rendered; null for html and conversions

title: Split a PDF
